scope: Within-participant/setting exploratory evaluation; common-session correlation remains; no unseen-person/session/environment claim
selection: maximum validation accuracy, earliest phase/epoch on ties; app selected among B0/B1/S1 by validation only
ablation: A0 versus S1: frozen randomly initialized versus ImageNet-pretrained ConvNeXtTiny; same Dense head seed 223, optimizer, batches, steps, epochs, no augmentation; backbone initialization is only factor
compute: CPU TensorFlow 2.21.0; 4 intra-op/2 inter-op threads; no paid services
test_isolation: Train/val only until all checkpoint selections frozen; test samples never used in training
metrics: accuracy, macro F1, per-class precision/recall/F1/support; zero_division=0; raw confusion counts
latency: batch1, 10 warmups,100 calls; classifier mean/median/p95; explanation/end-to-end separate
app: local Python HTTP server; upload/camera capture; loopback secure context; memory-only images; cached Keras model; no hosting or publication
limitations: dHash grouping does not establish independence
